name: spi4
title: ROX-SPI — 4-wire SPI master (mode 0)
description: Build a 4-wire SPI master (SCLK, MOSI, MISO, CS_N), mode 0 (CPOL=0, CPHA=0), 8 bits MSB-first, with a clock divider. Testbench prints spi4:PASS.
context: Parameter CLK_DIV (default 2). Idle: cs_n=1, sclk=0. On start (when busy=0) latch tx_data, cs_n=0, shift out 8 bits MSB-first on MOSI (sampling MISO on the rising edge, changing MOSI on the falling edge), then cs_n=1 and busy=0. Testbench CHECKs: idle cs_n=1; after start cs_n=0 and busy=1; MOSI presents the MSB of tx_data when the transfer starts; after 8 clocks cs_n=1 and busy=0. print spi4:PASS.

manifest.ports: input clk, input rst, input start, input [7:0] tx_data, input miso, output reg sclk, output reg mosi, output cs_n, output reg busy
manifest.behavior: idle cs_n=1,sclk=0; on start cs_n=0,busy=1, MOSI=tx_data MSB first; after transfer cs_n=1,busy=0. print spi4:PASS.
